description:
In `Program.fs`, the `sb` StringBuilder is a module-level mutable variable. If the extractor were ever called multiple times in the same process, the state would leak.

Fix: Pass `sb` through the walk functions as a parameter, or create it in `main` and pass it down. This is cosmetic for the current single-shot CLI use case, but good practice.

comments.text: Documented limitation with a comment in Program.fs. Full refactoring would require changing 15+ function signatures — not worth the code churn for a single-shot CLI tool. The comment explains when/how to refactor if the extractor is ever embedded in a larger application.

title: F# extractor: refactor module-level mutable StringBuilder
